{{Quote|A rain of fire is coming. The Scarred Man's hatred burns everything.|Meetra Surik|<ref name="Taral V" />}}
As the peace from the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] began to dissolve in [[3641 BBY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Fleet]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Oteg]] was contacted by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of the long-dead [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Meetra Surik]]. Surik implored Oteg to rescue a vital [[Revan/Legends|Jedi prisoner]] from [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], as the prisoner possessed information on the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] himself. To that end, Oteg gathered an elite strike team of [[Republic trooper|troopers]], Jedi, and other Republic-allied individuals to '''attack''' the [[Taral V Imperial fortress|Imperial fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taral V]] to recover a [[Gree computer|computer]] designed by the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that would allow the Republic fleet to navigate the Maelstrom.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The only way to navigate the Maelstrom is using a Gree computer hidden at an Imperial fortress. We need that computer to free the Jedi prisoner.|Fleet Admiral Oteg|<ref name="The Jedi Prisoner" />}}
In the aftermath of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|campaign of vengeance]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], as well as [[SpecForce Incident|other]] proxy conflicts,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the tenuous peace brought about by the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] began to fracture. Both the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] began preparing for war. It was around this time that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]],<ref name="The Jedi Prisoner" /> a former member of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], received a visit from the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of [[Meetra Surik]].<ref name="The Jedi Prisoner" /> Surik had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] over [[3950 BBY|three centuries]] earlier during a [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|failed attack]] on the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], and ever since she had been lending her strength to her ally [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] as the Emperor fed off of Revan's strength and knowledge.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>

Surik gave Oteg knowledge of Revan's predicament, and asked that the Jedi Master rescue him from his prison in the unnavigable [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. To reach the prison, Surik told Oteg to recover an [[Navigation computer/Legends|astrogation]] [[Gree computer|computer]] on [[Taral V]]&mdash;a computer designed by the mysterious [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. To that end, Oteg gathered an elite strike team of Jedi, [[Republic trooper]]s, and other Republic-allied individuals to retrieve the computer.<ref name="The Jedi Prisoner" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|My orders are to safeguard the fortress's contents at any cost. I've adopted a liberal interpretation of that command.|Grand Moff Kilran|<ref name="Taral V" />}}
Using a stolen Imperial shuttle, the strike team landed on Taral V near the [[Taral V Imperial fortress|main Imperial fortress]]. They then made their way up to the fortress' security outpost, fighting through the various [[Imperial soldier]]s, [[jurgoran]]s, [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], and [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial commandos]] that crowded their path. Handler [[Gattan]] and his pet [[vine cat]]s were killed in the process, and strike team's assault on the security outpost saw them destroy several Imperial war droids and eliminate over a dozen defenders. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shivanek]]'s futile last stand and death enraged his pet jurgoran [[Ripper (pet)|Ripper]], forcing the strike team to kill the large creature before deactivating the fortress' outer defenses. They then proceeded further up the path and crossed the bridge to main fortress.<ref name="Taral V" />

Within the fortress the strike team engaged a number of Imperial troops and additional jungle animals. After crossing a heavily defended bridge they moved into the fortress proper. After defeating [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zharen]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hasper]] they fought a power war droid at the entrance to the internal corridors. The strike team then confronted Kilran via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. The Imperial Moff declared his intention to bombard the fortress from orbit, but the strike team continued their mission despite this obstacle.<ref name="Taral V" />

Fighting through additional Imperial soldiers and [[Sith Warrior]]s the strike team reached the center of the fortress where they faced [[General/Legends|General]] [[Edikar]] and a group of [[Turret/Legends|turrets]]. The general was defeated, and the team confronted an Imperial researcher in possession of the Gree computer. The computer was handed over, but only after the strike team agreed to allow Imperial forces mapping the Maelstrom to evacuate. Eventually, Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] bombarded and destroyed the base from orbit in an unsuccessful attempt to prevent the Republic strike team to escape with the Gree technology.<ref name="Taral V" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|My technicians have plugged the Gree computer into the Telos's hyperdrive. We're already calculating a safe route to Maelstrom Prison. When we arrive, I need my best people leading the raid. You're the Jedi prisoner's only hope of escaping alive.|Fleet Admiral Oteg, to a Republic operative|<ref name="The Jedi Prisoner" />}}
The Gree navigation computer was later used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] to [[Battle of the Maelstrom|attack]] the [[Maelstrom Prison|Imperial prison]] in the [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom Nebula]] and rescue the Jedi Revan.<ref name="The Jedi Prisoner" />
